rationale: The web-compat DOM's insertBefore and replaceChild now keep the native widget order in step with the DOM child list. The __domAppend bridge call takes an optional sibling id to precede, and a move inside the same parent reorders through View::move_child_to_index instead of a detach and re-attach, so focus, drag and popup state in the moved row survive and its styles are not resent. Only the WidgetBridge DOM append path, its JS prelude and a WidgetBridge test change. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
